problem_this_addresses.what_happened: At the discriminating cell (depth 2 width 64, where nothing inducts) our arm WINS by -0.0344 at a 4.0% parameter handicap and LOSES by +0.0513 at a 15.9% one. The sign flips inside the bracket, so the four-cell 'the tax sign tracks copying availability, not depth' result rests at that cell on an interpolation to the ~7% handicap the other three cells carried, giving about -0.013.
problem_this_addresses.why_interpolation_is_not_enough: it assumes linearity in parameter fraction between two points 12 percentage points apart, and the interpolated margin is about a seventh of depth 1's. A conclusion that thin should be measured, not inferred.

the_fix.idea: no slot value puts OUR arm at -7%, because the slot mechanism moves the stream width in steps of 4 at depth 2 and the embedding dominates. But the CONVENTIONAL arm's size is freely tunable through its feed-forward expansion, so hold our arm fixed at slot 16 (645,168 parameters) and resize the conventional model instead.
the_fix.bracket: expansion 8 gives 688,256 -> our handicap 6.26%; expansion 9 gives 704,640 -> our handicap 8.44%. That brackets the -7% used at the other three cells to within about a point on each side, against the current -4.0%/-15.9% bracket which spans a sign change.
the_fix.cost: 2 conventional arms x 3 seeds, cap off = 6 cells. Our side is already trained.

P1_ours_wins_at_both.claim: Our slot-16 arm beats both conventional arms -- the tax is negative at a 6.26% handicap and at an 8.44% one.
P1_ours_wins_at_both.reason: the interpolation puts -7% at about -0.013, so both bracket points should land near it and on the same side; a sign change inside a two-point-wide bracket would be surprising given the sign change over the previous 12-point bracket was roughly linear.
P1_ours_wins_at_both.confidence: 0.55 -- the interpolated margin is thin enough that either bracket point could cross zero, which is exactly why this is being measured

P2_the_margin_is_thin.claim: Whichever way the signs fall, both taxes lie within +/-0.03 of zero -- an order of magnitude smaller than depth 1's -0.0905.

P3_what_a_split_would_mean.claim: If the two bracket points disagree in sign, the discriminating cell cannot support the four-cell claim at all and the claim reduces to three cells with depth and copying availability re-confounded.
P3_what_a_split_would_mean.note: this is not a prediction but a pre-committed reading, written now so it is not negotiated after the numbers arrive

what_this_still_cannot_settle: Even a clean two-sided win leaves copying availability entangled with WIDTH, since this cell differs from depth 2 width 128 in both. Only depth is cleanly excluded.

The conventional arms here are resized purely to match parameters; a wider feed-forward is not otherwise a fairer or less fair opponent, but it is a different model from the one used at the other cells.
